summary: Full frontend E2E for Corporate Admin account creation flow verified end-to-end. All 7 review-request scenarios PASS: (1) Master admin can create corporate client via Add Client modal with all required fields incl. contact_phone; (2) Draft->Review->Approve lifecycle transitions work and Approve triggers 'Corporate Admin access ready' modal (data-testid=corp-invite-modal) with copyable set-password link (corp-invite-link) + Copy button (corp-invite-copy); (3) Magic link (/auth/magic/<token>) shows magic-link-panel with billing email + set-password form, submitting Corp#12345 redirects to /admin/dashboard; (4) Corporate Admin nav now includes Feedback link and /admin/feedback renders (KPI cards + 'No feedback yet.'); (5) Fresh login at /login with billing email + new password lands on /admin/dashboard; (6) Resend admin invite button (resend-invite-<clientId>) present on Approved card and issues fresh distinct magic link; (7) Reused magic link shows 'Link no longer works — This link was already used' error (410 from backend). No frontend regressions observed.
